submitted_text:
Photo of USPS shipping receipt dated January 18, 2024, showing tracking number 9400111899223100567890. Receipt shows prepaid label for a package weighing 52 lbs.

I dropped the package at my local USPS location (Downtown Station, 450 Main St) on January 18th during business hours. The clerk scanned the label and accepted the package.

I'm aware the tracking hasn't updated beyond "label created" but USPS has been experiencing significant delays in my area. I've had other packages that didn't scan for up to a week before showing movement. The package was definitely dropped off — I have the receipt.
